pc-exile-play-1 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rules cited (eff.pcep1.self.cast.graveyardOrExile): its controller may cast it from their graveyard or from exile, as two permissions for the card itself, one for each zone, functioning in those zones (CR 601.3, 113.6b).

pc-exile-play-1 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rules cited (eff.exile, eff.pcep1.cast.spellsFromGroup.durFirst): the top seven cards of your library are exiled and, until end of turn, you may cast the spells among those cards (lands are not spells); if the spell was cast from your hand you add ten mana of any one color (CR 601.3, 400.7, 106.1).

pc-exile-play-1 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rules cited (trg.when, eff.exile, eff.pcep1.cast.spellsFromGroup.durFirst): when it deals combat damage to a player, as many cards from the top of your library as the damage dealt are exiled and until end of turn you may cast spells from among those exiled cards (CR 510.2, 601.3, 400.7).

pc-exile-play-1 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rules cited (trg.at, eff.exile, eff.pcep1.cast.spellsFromGroup.durFirst.anyColor): at the beginning of your upkeep the top card of each opponent's library is exiled and until end of turn you may cast spells from among those cards, spending mana as though it were mana of any color (CR 609.4b, 107.4c, 601.3).
